sections.title: Class places
sections.sql: select code,name,level,capacity,enrolled,places,waiting from class_capacity order by code

sections.title: Make-up credits
sections.sql: select code,student,expires_on,status from makeup_queue order by expires_on

sections.title: Lesson coverage
sections.sql: select code,name,scheduled,marked,missing,absent,last_present from attendance_watch order by code

sections.title: Level progress
sections.sql: select code,name,level,required,passed,last_assessed from skill_progress order by code

sections.title: Balances due
sections.sql: select code,family,due_on,currency,balance_cents from fee_balances where balance_cents>0 order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_flags order by rule,subject
sections.note: Evidence reminders only. Staff confirm applicability and current status with the issuing body.
